verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a crawling API, so the robots.txt and polite-crawling axis applies, but no documentation describes robots.txt compliance or automatic throttling against target sites. The rate-limits doc covers Context.dev's own per-minute API limits on customers, which is an adjacent control rather than target-site rate limiting. A community post quotes the vendor's opt-out block list and argues robots.txt is not followed; with no vendor claim to contradict, this does not create a dispute and only reinforces the absence of evidence.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can configure the crawler to respect robots.txt rules and target-site rate limits automatically
